headline: Claude demonstrates advanced mathematical reasoning in Riemann Hypothesis research
body: Anthropic's Claude model has shown improved mathematical capabilities, advancing research on the Riemann Hypothesis by expanding computational bounds from 41.6% to 67.2%. This development matters for healthcare AI because complex mathematical reasoning underpins drug discovery algorithms, genomic analysis, and predictive modeling in clinical research. Healthcare organizations evaluating LLMs for research support and data analysis should assess whether these improved reasoning capabilities translate to better performance on domain-specific calculations and hypothesis testing. However, recent Claude Code pricing changes (up to 40x token cost increase) signal vendor landscape shifts that could significantly impact healthcare AI deployment economics for computational workloads.
